changes.text: SILVERSIDES passed from command of this force to command of Commander Submarines, Southwest Pacific Force.
SILVERSIDES joined this command from Subsowespac.
DRUM passed to the command of Comtaskfor 17.
TINOSA passed to command of Commander Task Force Seventy-one.
